preregistration_notice: Frozen before any Phase 8 untouched-history outcome has been computed or viewed. Per the Part 2 untouched_history_inventory.json finding (completed immediately before this file, using only calendar-coverage bookkeeping and a read-only provider-availability probe -- no hypothesis-specific or strategy-outcome data of any kind was fetched or computed), zero genuinely untouched, currently-fetchable R_75 history exists. This plan is preregistered in full regardless, exactly as it would be executed once sufficient untouched history exists, so that its own sample-sufficiency stopping rule (Part 4) is what formally concludes this attempt. Immutable from this point forward; any future attempt is a new, separately versioned experiment_id.
atr_definition: Mean(high - low) over the trailing 14 completed M5 candles up to and including the decision candle (validation.strategy_feasibility not used here -- matches strategies/research/volatility_structure_pullback_hypothesis_v2.py::_stop_distance_atr exactly, which itself mirrors analysis/volatility_structure_pullback_engine.py's own internal ATR window convention).
primary_metric: conservative-cost mean realized R (net_r_conservative_cost), grouped by structural_episode_id, on the retained (variant-eligible) population of the untouched-history candidate universe.

cost_model.note: Identical for parent and variant; never lowered after any outcome is computed.

fill_policy: Identical to Phase 5/7 -- setup.entry at the first completed M5 candle where decision.trade_ready == true.

control_definitions.paired_opposite_direction: Same event, direction flipped, symmetric geometry.
control_definitions.random_direction: At least 1,000 deterministic seeded permutations, finite-sample p-value p = (1 + exceedances) / (N + 1), never exactly 0.
control_definitions.parent_vs_variant: Both evaluated on the identical untouched-history candidate universe; variant is always a subset of the parent's eligible setups.

retention_requirement: variant retains at least 50% of parent-eligible setups
drawdown_limit: Variant maximum drawdown must not exceed the parent's own drawdown scaled proportionally to the retained sample size.
direction_requirements: Both BUY and SELL must be represented in the retained population; a verdict is never issued from a single-direction sample.
maximum_positive_verdict: ELIGIBLE_FOR_SECOND_INDEPENDENT_REPLICATION -- never PRODUCTION_READY, LIVE_READY, AUTO_ELIGIBLE, PAPER_ELIGIBLE, or CONFIRMED_PROFITABLE.

untouched_data_boundaries.conclusion_carried_forward: RESEARCH_EXTENSION_REQUIRED_INSUFFICIENT_UNTOUCHED_HISTORY applies to this preregistered plan before Parts 5-12 (replay/controls/gates) are attempted.

no_changes_after_outcomes_are_viewed: This file is immutable from this point forward. No outcome of any kind was computed before it was written.
